variants.title: JFET transfer characteristic: specimen 1 of the batch
variants.sample: An unmarked n-channel JFET, specimen 1 (pinch-off voltage unknown)
variants.unknown: the pinch-off voltage V_P of this specimen
variants.note: The pinch-off voltage and I_DSS of a junction FET are not properties of a material: they depend on how the channel was doped and etched, and a datasheet only gives a wide range for the type. That is exactly why they are measured specimen by specimen rather than looked up. Each specimen in this batch is a different member of that spread.

source.title: A. S. Sedra and K. C. Smith, Microelectronic Circuits, JFET square law (I_D = I_DSS(1 - V_GS/V_P)^2); the specimen's own V_P is the quantity this experiment finds
